extracted.intended_audience: medical school faculty, staff, and other academic medicine professionals seeking professional development and networking opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: A directory page listing AAMC professional development offerings (conferences, webinars, workshops, certificate programs) with filters for type, format, status, and date; intended to help users find and register for relevant events and access related resources for presenters and exhibitors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offerings (type) filter
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter results by offering type: Certificate Program/Course, Conference/Meeting, Webinar, Workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page displays counts for each type (e.g., Certificate Program/Course (4), Conference/Meeting (113), Webinar (45), Workshop (33)). Use these categories to narrow searches to the format/structure of professional development most relevant to you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format filter
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter results by delivery format: In Person or Virtual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this filter to select events based on attendance mode (e.g., In Person (116) vs Virtual (86)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Status filter
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter results by event status: Registration is open, Upcoming, Past.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps identify events you can currently register for (Registration is open) versus future/planned offerings or archived/past events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date filter and date format
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter results by date ranges: Next Week, Next Month, Next Year, or a Custom Date Range. Date format: MM/DD/YYYY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows users to constrain search to a time window; the page provides UI for selecting 'From' and 'To' dates. Counts reflect items in each temporal bucket (e.g., Next Week (1), Next Month (7), Next Year (10)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Event listing elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Each event entry includes a title, a brief description of purpose/content, location (or 'Virtual'), date(s), time (when provided), and a 'Register' link/button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these elements to evaluate whether an offering meets your needs (e.g., topic relevance from the description, geographic feasibility from location, schedule compatibility from dates/times). Examples on the page include program blurbs such as 'The Restorative Practices in Academic Medicine (RPAM) Facilitator Training is a comprehensive, longitudinal program designed to equip participants with the skills needed to effectively understand the Restorative Practices (RP) processes...'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaker resources prompt
rubrics_metrics.description: Prompt to consult Speaker Resources for guidance when planning to deliver a presentation at an AAMC meeting: 'Examine tips and tools for planning, designing, and developing a terrific conference session.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the page does not list the tips, it directs prospective presenters to Speaker Resources for best practices on planning, designing, and developing conference sessions; use that resource to prepare proposals and presentations aligned with AAMC expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibit opportunities contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for organizations interested in exhibiting: 'Interested in exhibit opportunities at AAMC Events? Contact us for more information about AAMC events that fit your marketing strategy.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exhibitors are instructed to contact AAMC Meetings & Events to determine fit and opportunities; this implies a selection/fit review process handled via direct inquiry rather than self-serve registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community and networking access
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities to connect via AAMC Affinity Groups and Virtual Communities: 'Explore AAMC professional development groups — advance your career, and access exclusive opportunities for professional growth, networking, and collaboration.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page signals that joining affinity groups and virtual communities is a mechanism for ongoing professional development and networking beyond single events; evaluate these for membership benefits, networking potential, and resource-sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration and contact pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls to action and contact options: 'Register Now', 'Register', 'Fill out a form or email Meetings & Events', and 'Subscribe to receive the Professional Development Monthly Update.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit next steps for users: register for events, contact Meetings & Events for questions, or subscribe for updates. These pathways are the mechanisms for engagement and indicate how to access or inquire about offerings.
